## Dataset / API
Name, link, product & version:

## Why we need it
Variable, location, period, resolution:

## Minimum check (official)
- [ ] Source & version & license
- [ ] Variables & units, missing values
- [ ] Coverage (period, area, resolution)
- [ ] Limits (what it does NOT let us conclude)
- [ ] Small test done (sample in `data/samples/`)
- [ ] Traceability (observation / transformation / inference / synthetic)
- [ ] Listed in the official challenge Resources? yes / no
- [ ] Registered in `docs/nasa-data.md`
